statement: The related Human Resources Managers occupation (11-3121.00) covers acting as a link between management and employees and resolving work-related problems, the escalation layer above generalist roles.
quote: Serve as a link between management and employees by handling questions, interpreting and administering contracts and helping resolve work-related problems.

scope.geography: United States (onsite, hybrid or US-remote roles located in the US)
scope.seniority: mid-level individual contributor (excludes intern/junior/entry and principal/director-and-above titles)
